name: print-social-repeated-italic-serif-word-behind-cutout-popcorn-bucket
title: Six rows of pink italic serif POPCORN on blue behind a striped popcorn bucket
whatItIs: A dusty blue portrait with the word POPCORN repeated six times in large pink italic serif capitals, filling the frame. A 3D-style striped pink-and-white bucket of popcorn rises from the bottom, overlapping the lower rows.
whatItMeans: Sweet, nostalgic and instantly readable; repetition turns a word into a pattern.
techniques: Repeat one word to fill the frame as a pattern.
Let the product cut-out overlap the text rows.
Use elegant italic serif for a soft, cinematic tone.

vocabulary.definition: Repeating a word to create a texture.
An object cut over the text layer.
